page.layout: Two columns. Left margin: marginal notes beside the upper and middle part of the column. Main column at right, with the list of names in groups, one group per year. Years in a narrow column at the far right of the main column, one beside each group. Page number "30" at the top of the main column. No running head.

p.note: Rursum fœdus renovatū civitati cum agro vicino, & novum percussum cum ordinibus Frisiæ Orient, contra CAROLVM BVRG.
Fridericus III Imp. confirmavit pacta civitatis & agri, & libertatem iuraq; populi.

page.notes: The years 1471 to 1477 stand in a separate narrow column at the far right of the list; each is appended to the last line of its group. The left-margin notes have no host text, so they are placed in a paragraph before the list. "Garmet" is followed by a mark that I could not read with certainty, shown as [?]. The printed "1475" and "1476" are as printed; the last digit of "1471" and "1474" was read from a small, uneven figure. Long s is given as plain s throughout, including in "strusta" (read as "strusta").
